::: {#exm-layer-norm}

#### `nn.LayerNorm` on one image

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(64)
row_normed = layer_norm(pre[:1]).detach()
print(row_normed.mean().item(), row_normed.std(correction=0).item())
```

`nn.LayerNorm(64)` applies [layer normalization](#def-layer-norm) to each row of its input [@pytorch_layernorm].
For the first training image alone,
its 64 outputs have mean `r sprintf("%.1e", py$row_normed$mean()$item())`
and standard deviation `r sprintf("%.3f", py$row_normed$std(correction = 0L)$item())`.

:::
